title: Two-sided 3D hardcover book with live HTML pages
blurb: Six live HTML pages bound as a hardcover book in one WebGL 2 canvas. Drag a corner to curl both the front and the mirrored back of a leaf over the spine, while checkboxes, inputs, notes and text selection keep working on the open spread.
question: Can a multi-page book curl both the front and back of a live HTML leaf across a shaded spine in WebGL while links, checkboxes, notes and text selection keep working on the open spread?
result: Built with one ElementGL WebGL 2 context, a 28 by 18 cylindrical curl mesh and a 2D folded-slice fallback. Live browser measurements on Chromium 157 and Chrome 159 on Android are not verified yet: press Run on the live checks below to test your browser.
